questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: It was easy to find. I found my housing on Spotahome and paid €650 per month.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Milan has an ok public transportation system, but choose something close to the city center. (If possible)

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer:
The course registration happens during the first few weeks, where you can go from course to course to see which courses fits your academic preferences.
The process was rather unorganized though (as with most things at the University of Milan)

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: I figured it out together with other students, as official information was only scarcely available from the university.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: I was successful

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer:
Take it easy. The process is unorganized - but it all works out.

Take classes with friends

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: The level of courses is lower than KU

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer:
Traditional teaching style.

“Back to school”- kind of vibe, school everyday from morning to afternoon

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
1) CORPORATE GOVERNANCE AND SOCIAL RESPONSABILITY
- Difficulty high, Recommendable
2) COMPARATIVE LABOUR LAW
- Difficulty very low, Recommendable
3) SMART CITIES, ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE AND DIGITAL TRANSFORMATION LAW
- Difficulty: Very low, recommendable
4) SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT IN GLOBAL TRADE (WTO) LAW
Difficulty: Medium, Recommendable 
5) INTERNATIONAL COMMERCIAL AND INVESTMENT ARBITRATION
Difficulty: High, Not recommendable

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Don’t choose M&A: The contract, unless you want to have a workload equivalent to 3 other courses :)

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
1) Focus on networking, socializing and finding friends for life. Focus less on the academics.
2) Rent a bike! 
3) Enjoy Italian food and drinks
